column4: Which Rust type allows shared ownership across threads: A) Arc B) Rc? Reply with only A or B.
Which type permits single-threaded interior mutability checked at runtime: A) Mutex B) RefCell? Reply with only A or B.
Does moving a non-Copy String normally invalidate the previous binding? Reply with only yes or no.
Is a shared reference &T normally allowed to mutate T without interior mutability? Reply with only yes or no.
Which Rust trait permits implicit bitwise copying: A) Clone B) Copy? Reply with only A or B.
Which operation waits asynchronously without blocking a Tokio worker: A) tokio::time::sleep(...).await B) std::thread::sleep(...)? Reply with only A or B.
What Rust keyword declares an asynchronous function before fn? Reply with only the keyword.
Which Rust Option variant represents absence? Reply with only the variant name without parentheses.
Which Rust Result variant represents failure? Reply with only the variant name without parentheses.
Can a Rust future be cancelled by dropping it before completion? Reply with only yes or no.
Does an unbounded queue impose a fixed capacity limit on queued messages? Reply with only yes or no.
Which avoids holding a synchronous mutex guard across await: A) drop the guard before await B) keep the guard across await? Reply with only A or B.
Which prevents SQL injection: A) escaping HTML B) parameterized SQL statements? Reply with only A or B.
Should an authorization check be enforced on the server even if the UI hides the action? Reply with only yes or no.
Is base64 encoding by itself encryption? Reply with only yes or no.
Which prevents directory traversal: A) resolve and enforce the allowed root B) concatenate the user path to the root? Reply with only A or B.
Which protects stored passwords better: A) plain SHA-256 without salt B) a salted password hashing function such as Argon2id? Reply with only A or B.
Should a production log contain a user's plaintext password? Reply with only yes or no.
Can a time-of-check/time-of-use race occur when opening a path after checking it? Reply with only yes or no.
Which is appropriate for unpredictable authentication tokens: A) operating-system cryptographic randomness B) the current timestamp alone? Reply with only A or B.
Which avoids a shell injection boundary for untrusted arguments: A) interpolate them into sh -c B) pass them as separate arguments without a shell? Reply with only A or B.
What does the abbreviation TLS expand to? Reply with exactly the three words and no punctuation.
What is the default TCP port for HTTP? Reply with only the integer.
Should access be denied when an authorization policy cannot be evaluated reliably? Reply with only yes or no.
